title: BLD-556: Add --full flag to hlx library show
description: Walkthrough of the --full flag implementation that prints the full markdown body of library items after the TOC

steps.title: Import hasFlag utility
steps.description: Added import for hasFlag from the shared flags module. This is the same pattern used by 7+ other commands (--json, --dry-run, --archived, --force, --current).

steps.title: Rename _args to args
steps.description: The third parameter was already passed from the router but was unused (underscore prefix convention). Renamed to 'args' to signal intent to use it for flag detection.

steps.title: Existing null guard (unchanged)
steps.description: The existing null-content guard returns early with 'No content available.' This fires before both the TOC loop and the new --full block, so null content is handled safely without any additional code.

steps.title: Core feature: --full flag conditional
steps.description: After the heading-parsing for-loop completes (TOC output), check if --full was passed. If so, print a markdown horizontal rule separator followed by the full item.content. This is the entire feature — one conditional with two console.log calls.

steps.title: Updated help text for show subcommand
steps.description: Expanded the single-line help to a multi-line template literal that includes the [--full] flag in the usage line and a Flags section describing what --full does.

steps.title: Updated top-level usage text
steps.description: Added [--full] to the library show line in the top-level hlx --help output, maintaining alignment with surrounding lines.

steps.title: Updated skill documentation
steps.description: Updated the code block to show [--full] and added a flag table following the same pattern used by the library comments list and post sections nearby.
